links.outcome: Correct diagnosis as top-1 and top-3 diagnoses, ChatGPT-4 versus rheumatologists on same cases
links.effect: Top diagnosis 35% vs 39% (p = 0.30); among top 3, 60% vs 55% (p = 0.38); higher sensitivity for IRD but lower specificity than rheumatologists.
links.quote: ChatGPT-4 listed the correct diagnosis comparable often to rheumatologists as the top diagnosis 35% vs 39% (p = 0.30); as well as among the top 3 diagnoses, 60% vs 55%, (p = 0.38).

screen.reason: Evaluates the diagnostic accuracy of ChatGPT-4 compared to rheumatologists using retrospective patient assessment data without testing a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
